name: Krechet-94
tagline: The Soviet lunar suit that never flew — its DNA lives in every Orlan and Feitian
description: Soviet lunar surface suit developed for the cancelled N1/L3 crewed lunar program. Single-piece rear-entry design with the PLSS built into the back hatch — the architectural pattern shared with the Orlan (both developed concurrently in 1967–1969) and later adopted by the Feitian. Krechet hardware survived the program's cancellation and lives in museum collections (notably the Memorial Museum of Cosmonautics, Moscow). Name means "gyrfalcon" — the largest of the Falcon birds.
best_known_for: The Soviet lunar suit that never reached the Moon — its rear-entry architecture became the DNA of every Russian and Chinese EVA suit since
